provenance.writtenFor: Ultimate Master Pump synthetic evaluation breadth batch 2 (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A container image runs its process as root, so a compromise keeps root inside the container.

groundTruth.rationale: USER root removes the unprivileged-account boundary that limits the blast radius of a process compromise.

limitations: Line-level lexical detection only; the rule is a review prompt, not proof of exploitability.
